hypotheses.F0_qk_value_singletons_are_exact: For every layer, QK plus current-value singleton paths reconstruct the corresponding complete attention singleton with maximum relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.F1_singletons_explain_attention_program: Identity plus all ten QK/value singleton paths retains at least 0.995 full-analytic fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.F2_four_factor_paths_are_high_fidelity: Four discovery-frozen factor paths retain at least 0.98 full-analytic fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.F3_qk_routing_dominates_value_response: Identity plus all five QK paths exceeds identity plus all five value paths by at least 0.005 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.F4_factor_paths_beat_random: At budget four, the frozen factor program exceeds the identity-plus-random factor 95th percentile by at least 0.01 on every corpus.
hypotheses.F5_factor_program_transfers_ood: Frozen four-factor fidelity on each OOD corpus is within 0.03 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.F6_compact_factor_and_mlp_program_predic: Replacing identity by the frozen four-path MLP approximation and retaining the selected nonidentity factor paths predicts finite native effects with at least 0.94 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.F7_context_specific_factor_selection_is_: At budget four, the per-example factor oracle exceeds the frozen factor program by less than 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.F8_qk_branch_asymmetry_is_small: The two exchangeable QK branches have aggregate local attention-response norms within a factor of two on every corpus.
